She is taking non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs for pain relief, a known risk factor for diverticulitis.
Pouches form where the colonic mucosa herniates into the bowel wall. In diverticulitis, these pouches become inflamed.
Symptoms include severe lower abdominal pain, fever, nausea and a change in bowel habit.
So the single best diagnosis is diverticulitis.
